name: Monitor till cash leaks with Google Sheets, Gmail, Telegram and OpenAI

parameters.content:
## Cash Leak Watchdog — reconcile the till and catch the pattern, not just the day

**Who it's for:** small-shop owners who close the till every night and want discrepancies caught early — especially the slow leak that only shows up when the same shift keeps coming up short.

**How it works:** a nightly schedule (or the manual demo) loads till entries — date, shift, staff, expected sales, counted cash — plus the prior 30 days of history. Each submission is validated, deduped by date+shift and checked against an editable tolerance band (the larger of a flat amount or a percent of sales). Days nobody submitted are inferred from gaps in the sequence. Then the differentiator: a cash variance is noise once — the same staff/shift over band 3 times in 30 days is a pattern, and it escalates to a separate urgent channel. Malformed rows park in a quarantine queue instead of being dropped. One owner digest closes every run with the cumulative 30-day leak total.

**Setup:** ~2 minutes, zero credentials. Click Test workflow — the bundled data exercises every branch: a clean day, an escalated repeat offender, a duplicate, a malformed row and a 3-day submission gap.

**Requirements:** none for demo. Production enables the greyed-out nodes: a Google Sheet as the till log, Gmail for first-offense alerts, Telegram for escalations and the daily digest.

**Customize:** the RULES block in the Reconcile node — tolerance_abs, tolerance_pct, escalate_after, history_days.

nodes.name: Read today's till entries
nodes.notes: Production intake: the Sheet tab the cashier fills at close. Columns: date, shift, staff, expected_sales, counted_cash.

nodes.name: Read prior-30d till log
nodes.notes: The accumulated till log — powers cumulative leak totals and repeat-offender escalation. A filter on date >= today-30d keeps the window bounded.

nodes.name: Append verdict to till log
nodes.notes: Clean days write back to the log — the log becomes tomorrow's 30-day history.

nodes.name: Email owner alert
nodes.notes: First offenses and submission gaps — the daily-operational channel.

nodes.name: Escalation ping
nodes.notes: Repeat offenders get the urgent channel — a pattern is worth paging for, a single variance is not.

nodes.name: Park row in quarantine
nodes.notes: Malformed or duplicate rows park here instead of being dropped. Fix the row in the till log and the next sweep reprocesses it.

nodes.name: Send daily digest
nodes.notes: Exactly one owner digest per run — totals, cumulative leak, and every alert listed.

parameters.content:
### Two intake lanes

**Demo:** the Code node emits a till log (history + today) with the dirty rows a real shop produces.

**Production:** enable the two greyed Google Sheets reads — today's entries plus the prior-30-day log — and delete the demo node. Greyed nodes pass data through untouched, so the demo runs end-to-end even with them on the canvas.

### The mechanism, not just a route

A single variance is noise — the same staff over band 3 times in 30 days is a pattern. History rows are scored before today is judged, so repeat offenses route to escalation while first offenses get a normal alert.

Edit RULES in the Reconcile node: tolerance band, escalate_after, history window.

### Nothing silently drops

Over-band → owner alert. Repeat pattern → escalation channel. Missing days → gap alert. Bad rows → quarantine queue that reprocesses when fixed.

The digest is computed inside Reconcile after every verdict — exactly one per run, and an empty branch can never starve it.

### ⚠ Enable = sends real messages

The greyed nodes are disabled on purpose — the demo never sends. Enabling Gmail/Telegram/Sheets makes this write rows and message the owner. Attach your own credentials first.
